children: GenusPlus's acquisition of Universal Communications Group will fast-track the Australian company's overall growth strategy, according to its bull at Bell Potter. Analyst Joseph House explains in a note that the infrastructure construction and maintenance provider's acquisition of UCG, which has a long relationship with New Zealand's largest telco infrastructure owner, adds scale and capability. He writes that the move accelerates GenusPlus's multi-market growth strategy across communications, transmission, wind, rail and gas. It also opens the door to other critical infrastructure markets in New Zealand, he adds. Bell Potter keeps a buy rating on the stock with a target price of 12.80 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.1% at A$9.30. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
